A_beam_cantilever.element: 2-node cubic Hermite Euler-Bernoulli frame element (tensorfem.frame2d, 3 dof per node)
A_beam_cantilever.physics: Euler-Bernoulli cantilever, tip load P and uniform load q

observations.order_note: the tip-load field is a cubic, which the Hermite element spans exactly: the reported tip-load errors are a round-off floor, not a converged discretisation, so no order is measurable for that load case; the uniform-load interior field supplies the measurable order

B_plate_ssss_uniform.element: 4-node Mindlin-Reissner plate element, MITC4 assumed shear strain (tensorfem.plate.q4_mindlin_stiffness)
B_plate_ssss_uniform.physics: Kirchhoff/Mindlin square plate, soft simple support, uniform pressure

reference.w_centre_timoshenko: alpha q a^4 / D, alpha = 0.00406 (Timoshenko table 8) = 2.1112000000e-03 m

observations.order_note: the centre deflection error is not monotone: at n = 32 it sits at ~0.3 %, above its n = 16 value (7e-4), so its observed order is not a usable rate.  The L2 norm of the deflection field is monotone and second order, which is the rate this case is graded on.

C_cylinder_lame.physics: thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure, plane strain, Lame solution

reference.recovery: Gauss -> nodal bilinear extrapolation (weights (1 +- sqrt3)/2) plus averaging of the sharing elements

observations.order_note: the recovered pointwise stress is second order; the raw Gauss values are first order and are reported for transparency.
